experiments.question: Should the 32 sigma atoms be collapsed to a point at the median?

Jensen mechanism refuted -- P(touch) is CONCAVE in sigma at 0.5-3%, convex only at 5%. Rule condition (c) was unsatisfiable: 5 of 6 years required, 3 exist.

experiments.question: Is the one-day volatility lag fixable, or an information ceiling?
experiments.rule: a spike classifier must clear a shuffled-target permutation null
experiments.result: information IS present: spike-tomorrow AUC 0.777 (logistic, both populations) clearing AUC and DSC nulls. Decomposed independently: continuation AUC 0.929 but ONSET only 0.733, CI [0.655,0.805], still clearing a shuffled null (p95 0.564). So 7a's 'structural' claim is WITHDRAWN, and the prize is bounded by the 0.73 onset signal, not the 0.78 headline. Two levers measured, neither adopted: 3x spike upweighting (pooled QLIKE -5.6%, spike -25.9%, calm +1.7%) and har_1h/har_6h in the linear anchor (pooled -7.33%, onset -5.48%).

experiments.question: Are the three open defects (untrained reg_post_etf, unused capacity, global-vs-hourly adaptive correction) real?
experiments.rule: reg_post_etf: measure how much the LIVE prediction moves when the untrained input is zeroed, not whether removing it improves an average. capacity: compare hidden-layer effective rank against the effective rank of the INPUT matrix -- if inputs span ~10 dims a rank-12 layer is correct behaviour. adaptive: rule stated by the agent before running.
experiments.result: capacity: WITHDRAWN false alarm -- Stage B is Linear(22->32) so 32 is an unreachable denominator, and activations carry 13 dims against inputs spanning 13. reg_post_etf: real but moves sigma_med 0.169% and P(touch 2%) 0.17-0.29pp -- fix at next retrain, not urgent. hour-conditional correction: peak cal error -44.6% but CI [-0.0071,+0.0014] contains zero and hour pools median 60 episodes vs 1422 global; NOT adopted. Unplanned: the shipped global correction worsens mean QLIKE +0.00613 CI [0.0030,0.0094].

experiments.question: Is the low hidden-layer effective rank a training defect?
experiments.rule: compare achieved activation rank against the INPUT's effective rank and the architectural ceiling, not against nominal width
experiments.result: false alarm: Stage B carries 13 dims against inputs spanning 13; Stage A 17 against 19

experiments.question: Do spike-upweighting or anchor-freshness survive a proper walk-forward?
experiments.rule: 6-fold walk-forward at 3 seeds: pooled QLIKE improves in >=5 of 6 folds AND spike RV/sigma moves toward 1.0 AND calm-episode QLIKE worsens by no more than 3%
experiments.result: 3x spike upweighting, 6 folds x 3 seeds: pooled QLIKE 4/6 (bar 5) FAIL; RV/sigma toward 1.0 OK; calm cost -0.02% OK. Rule AND bootstrap agree -- pooled CI [-0.01647,+0.00018] contains zero, so this is not 6l. What the lever does do: spike QLIKE -0.16526 CI [-0.22739,-0.10217] and spike |RV/sigma-1| -0.05095 CI [-0.06080,-0.04255], both excluding zero, at no measurable calm cost. Diluted by spikes being 6.08% of episodes. Rule-design error recorded: 12 made pooled QLIKE primary for a lever aimed at 6% of episodes.

experiments.question: Does spike upweighting pass a SPIKE-CONDITIONAL rule?
experiments.rule: spike-conditional QLIKE with a moving-block bootstrap CI excluding zero AND spike RV/sigma toward 1.0 AND calm QLIKE not worsening more than 1% with its own CI; pooled QLIKE reported but NOT a condition
experiments.result: specified, not yet run

experiments.question: Do the harvested funding/DVOL series have usable history depth?

experiments.result: route works -- GH Actions runner committed both files. Funding VERIFIED better than cited: hourly, 64,206 rows, 2019-04-30 onward, 32,196 rows (50.1%) inside the training window. DVOL unusable as harvested: 15 days, 383 rows, ZERO training-window overlap, because get_historical_volatility is REALIZED vol with no time range, not the implied DVOL index. Fixed to page get_volatility_index_data; unverified from container.

experiments.question: Does the committed benchmark reproduce at SHA ab170b4?
experiments.rule: re-run eval.benchmark --folds all; every headline metric (QLIKE, pinball, CRPS, Brier/DSC/MCB at every barrier) within 0.5% relative of benchmark.json. Seeds fixed 0,1,2, so a larger deviation means non-determinism, which BLOCKS all later phases.
experiments.result: gate v1 VOID -- named a nonexistent flag (--folds all) and a nonexistent committed file (model/artifacts is gitignored), and used relative tolerance on near-zero metrics (1421% on a 1e-5 quantity). It DID establish that benchmark.json was stale: climatology bit-identical at 0.000% while persistence, a baseline with no training, moved 3.16%. Data moved, not the optimizer. Wall clock 592s, peak RSS 1.70GB.

experiments.question: Does the paged DVOL index endpoint deliver training-window history?

experiments.result: 47,563 hourly rows, 2021-03-24 -> 2026-08-26, 15,552 inside the training window (was 383 rows / 15 days / 0 overlap). Also corrects the repo's own citation of '1,000 daily closes from 2023-09' -- the index endpoint gives hourly from 2021-03.

experiments.question: Is the benchmark pipeline deterministic run-to-run?
experiments.rule: two runs, identical inputs, seeds 0/1/2: every metric must agree within 1e-9 absolute OR 0.1% relative where |value| > 1e-4. Reproducing the stale artifact is explicitly NOT a condition.
experiments.result: PASS. Two runs, identical inputs: all 351 metrics BIT-IDENTICAL, worst absolute difference 0.000e+00. The pipeline is fully deterministic, so gate v1's failure was 100% stale artifact and 0% nondeterminism.

experiments.question: Does the headline benchmark train the same configuration that ships?
experiments.rule: compare the evaluation path's run_fold call against train_v2's trainer configuration
experiments.result: NO. benchmark.py:514 calls run_fold without sigma_ref_fn, so Stage B trains against realized RV -- which prepare()'s own docstring documents as a train/serve skew manufacturing Spearman -0.4331. train_v2.py uses the causal reference and stamps it into the artifact; 6b records that as an ADOPTED fix. Fourth measured-vs-shipped defect here. check_measured_is_shipped could not catch it -- it compares artifact metadata, not the eval path. New check 10 added.

experiments.result: corrected config adopted unconditionally as pre-registered. QLIKE 0.289605 -> 0.290346 (+0.256%, WORSE); MCB up 2% -2.637%; DSC/UNC dn 2% +7.11%. experiments.result: YES. BASE_COLS = har_1d/har_5d/har_22d/cal_H/cal_weekend_frac; har_1h and har_6h are absent. BLEND_W=0.25 so Log-HAR carries 75%. experiments.question: Diagnostics from the E-anchor runs before a verdict exists
experiments.rule: record what the partial runs established, separately from the experiment's own pre-registered rule
experiments.result: (1) My pre-registered guard 're-score log_har_gauss' rested on a FALSE premise: fit_vol_baselines uses its own VOL_BASELINES dict, not BASE_COLS, so log_har is independent of the treatment. Confirmed empirically -- logHAR identical to 4dp across arms in folds 2021 (0.3591) and 2022 (0.2851). Harmless over-specification, but the guard was checking something that could not move. (2) Partial results, 2 of 6 folds, NOT a verdict: fresh_anchor was slightly WORSE on both pooled (0.3369->0.3417, 0.2745->0.2766) and spike (3.2380->3.2775, 1.3542->1.3739). If that holds, 12's Arm 4 OLS-harness gain does not survive the full pipeline.
